lat.description: WGS-84 latitude in degrees, paired with `lng`. REQUIRED with `lng` unless `place`/`q` is provided.

lng.description: WGS-84 longitude in degrees, paired with `lat`. REQUIRED with `lat` unless `place`/`q` is provided.

place.description: Free-text place name (e.g. 'Mount Everest', 'Tokyo'). REQUIRED unless `lat`+`lng` is provided. Aliases also accepted: `q`, `query`, `name`.

q.description: Alias for `place`, accepted because OSM/Mapbox/Google Geocoding all use `q`. Provide either this or `place` (or `lat`+`lng`).
